subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'EDUCATION' is written as 'GFWCATKQP' and ‘PROFESSOR’ is written as ‘RTQFESUQT’. How will 'FACULTIES' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic :

 
• First three and last three letters→ (2) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• Fourt, fifth and sixth letter → No change.

​So,

 
• ​'EDUCATION' is written as 'GFWCATKQP'​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/324df81066c89f41372aad6212426571aa2a119587a2a93517ad0e949d75bb1a.png] 

​And,

 
• ‘PROFESSOR’ is written as ‘RTQFESUQT’

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b55b7acd495c86f2cc0733a41e988e3e554dee88c6089059881745c2dd150e57.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• 'FACULTIES' is written as :​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cddf02ea202df90b0a0ea34af7db19eec86700fe3ce4298c36f6e1030b4d2ab8.png] 

Hence, **"HCEULTKGU**" is the correct answer.
